text:
rachel: Quick note from todays onboarding: the Next Edge LangChain quickstart hung for a new user. Request to /api/assistant stayed pending.

tony: Was this with ephemeral keys or normal API key?

rachel: Ephemeral token rotation enabled in sample. Repro: hit rotation while a request is inflight, SDK retried but the edge route never got an error.

kevin: Minimal handler snippet looked normal. Myself and a new hire saw it twice in 30 mins.

rachel: Workaround I put in the repo: instantiate SDK with `retry: { maxRetries: 0 }` in the example so devs don't hit the hang during quickstart. Not ideal long-term.

tony: Can you add a small e2e that mocks auth server returning 401 once and assert the route returns 401/400 instead of hanging?

rachel: Yep added test branch and a failing CI job.

docs-bot: Created DOCS ticket DOC-1301 to add an "Edge runtime auth retry" callout in the quickstart and sample README.

ci-bot: CI run 7890 failed on test edge-auth-repro (flaky) see runs/7890

kevin: Plan: patch SDK to treat auth exchange 401/403 as non-retriable, land e2e, then update sample to friendly retry defaults. I'll PR the SDK patch.

rachel: Thanks — I'll update the quickstart example with the temporary workaround and link the ticket.
